B-tracking complete, strict red-green-refactor. Gate ALL green: tsc clean, lint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest 821 pass, build OK (TrackingPage 17.08 kB own chunk; Leaflet code-split into TrackingMapInner chunk, verified NOT in TrackingPage chunk), size 213.44 kB brotli < 260 kB.

=== KEY DECISIONS ===
(1) TWO-MODE DETECTION (trackingMode.ts pure): token present -> 'authed' (token wins even when a ?k= link token is also present); logged-out + ?k= -> 'public'; logged-out no ?k= -> 'none'. TrackingPage calls BOTH useTrackingAuthed + useTrackingPublic unconditionally (rules of hooks) but passes empty code/null token to the inactive one; each hook gates its queries on a non-empty code (enabled) so only the active mode fetches (proven: public-mode test asserts getOrderByCode NOT called).
(2) THE ID-FROM-CODE LINCHPIN (advisor-confirmed): the route param is publicCode, and NEITHER orders/by-code NOR public/track returns the order id or (authed) the id needed for Subscribe/cancel. useTrackingAuthed resolves the id via getMyActiveOrder ({id,publicCode,status}) matched on publicCode===code, then loads getOrder(id) for the full detail (price). Cancel + Subscribe are only meaningful for non-terminal orders == exactly what getMyActiveOrder returns. Data sources: authed VM = by-code DTO (driver/vehicle/pickup/dropoff/position) + full detail (price: final->fixed->estimate, and live-patched status); public VM = public/track DTO (incl displayPriceCzk). Reuses existing query keys ['orders','mine','active'] + ['orders','detail',id] + new ['orders','track','by-code',code] / ['orders','track','public',code,token].
(3b) MONEY FORMAT: the Completed headline ('Hotovo – {{price}} Kč') formats {{price}} with Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ') in StatusHeadline.tsx BEFORE interpolation (so 1200 -> '1 200'); the ' Kč' suffix stays in the i18n template. The details-block price uses the shared formatCzk helper.

(3) ETA 15s REFRESH DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT (advisor-confirmed; conflicts with TASK PROSE but follows the DESIGNER handoff which is the operative WI def). TrackOrderResponse.EtaMinutes is always null pre-06 (OSRM is assignment 06), so the headline omits '~min' when eta is null (headline key assignedNoEta). A 15s ETA-refresh timer would be provably dead code today and the designer's acceptance list contains NO ETA-refresh test (only the 10s public poll). statusHeadline supports the eta path (assignedEta key) for when 06 lands. *** CONFLICT FLAGGED: the task prose asked for a 15s ETA-refresh timer + test; I did not build it per the source-grounded deferral. ***
(4) SINGLE HUB SINGLETON: useTrackingAuthed calls useFleetHub() (the session-wide /hubs/fleet singleton — /c did not mount it before; AppLayout/DriverLayout do for dispatcher/driver) so invokeHub('Subscribe', orderId) has a live connection. Subscribe is invoked in a useEffect gated on orderId!=null && connectionState==='connected'. The customer FleetHub.Subscribe path (IgnoreQueryFilters + CustomerUserId==sub, verified UC-001/003) is tenant-safe. Never a second connection.
(5) CACHE-PATCH-NOT-REFETCH + STALE GUARD: useFleetHub's OrderChanged handler ALREADY ran shouldIgnoreOrderChanged (the version stale guard the AC wants). Change: on OrderChanged it now setQueryData-patches ['orders','detail',id] IN PLACE (status/driverId/version) FIRST for an instant status flip (customer headline + dispatcher drawer, no blank), THEN invalidates the same key. The OrderChanged payload carries NO price/note (only status/driverId/version), so the invalidate is what keeps BOTH the dispatcher drawer's price/note AND the customer's finalPriceCzk (Meter/Estimate settled at completion) correct — invalidate refetches only OBSERVED queries (the tracking detail query + the open drawer), an unobserved cache keeps the optimistic patch for its next read. This preserves the dispatcher drawer's pre-existing live full-detail refresh (advisor-flagged potential regression — resolved by keeping the invalidate alongside the patch; the 33-file board/orders/realtime suite stays green). Marker moves via DriverPositionChanged -> usePositionStore (keyed by driverId) -> selectCarMarker (pure: live store entry wins, else DTO last-known position).
(6) RATING SEAM for B-rating: StatusHeadline takes an optional ratingSlot ReactNode prop, rendered when descriptor.showRating (Completed). TrackingPage does not pass one yet, so a default placeholder ('Ohodnoťte prosím svoji jízdu.') shows. B-rating drops RatingForm into that slot (pass ratingSlot={<RatingForm orderId=.../>} from TrackingPage) with NO refactor of this screen. NO rating POST implemented here.
(7) CANCEL: shown only in New/Assigned/Accepted (headlineRules.showCancel) AND only when orderId is known (authed, non-terminal). CancelDialog = focus-trapping modal, exactly two buttons (spec §11), Escape closes + returns focus to the trigger, post-Accepted hint ('Řidič už jede...'). Cancel POSTs orders/{id}/cancel with { reason: 'Zrušeno zákazníkem' } + the customer JWT (server records CancelledByRole=Customer from the JWT, NOT from the reason text — verified in the designer notes). 409 -> 'Objednávku už nelze zrušit' shown IN the dialog; the dialog STAYS OPEN on 409 and closes on success. useCancelOrder.cancel() returns a boolean outcome (true=success) and TrackingPage's onConfirm branches on that return value — NOT on the captured cancel.errorKey, which would be a stale closure frozen at the render when the dialog opened (advisor-caught bug; a dedicated test asserts the dialog stays open + shows the error on 409). useCancelOrder reads error.status via a structural guard (not instanceof) mirroring the driver useOfferAccept pattern.
(8) PUSH PROMPT: client permission ONLY (Notification.requestPermission) — actual Web Push SENDING deferred to assignment 05 (documented in xmldoc). Feature-detects Notification!==undefined && 'PushManager' in window (jsdom-safe: renders nothing in jsdom, no crash). Renders only when permission==='default'; hides on allow/dismiss.
(9) EXPIRED LINK (AC#3): public 410 Tracking.LinkExpired -> useTrackingPublic.isExpired -> TrackingPage shows 'Odkaz vypršel' + <CallButton> (falls back to the persisted fleet phone). Polling STOPS on 410 (refetchInterval returns false). 'none' mode (logged-out no token) shows a login-needed message + call. Offline/no-data-yet shows 'Načítáme...' + call, never blank (last-known-state).
(10) LAZY LEAFLET: TrackingMap (React.lazy -> TrackingMapInner) mirrors PickupMap/RideMapStrip; collapsed by default; verified build grep: NO leaflet in the TrackingPage chunk (it lands in TrackingMapInner chunk). Car + pickup markers are read-only.
(11) ROUTER: added lazy /c/t/:code nested UNDER CustomerLayout (shell CallButton + ensureFleetSlug slug-persistence + silent-refresh). Safe for logged-out public links because public/track + public/fleet are AllowAnonymous (return 410/404, never 401) so CustomerLayout's on-401 silent-refresh never redirects a public tracker to /c/login.

=== CLIENT.TS ADDITIONS ===
TrackDto + TrackPositionDto (shared authed/public shape); getOrderByCode(code) -> GET orders/by-code/{code} (CustomerOnly authed tracking, returns TrackDto; no order id/price in payload — hence the getMyActiveOrder id resolution); getPublicTrack(code, token) -> GET public/track/{code}?k= (AllowAnonymous, skipAuthRedirect:true, 410->ApiResponseError). postCancelOrder already existed (reused).

=== NEW TRAP (CLAUDE.md candidate) ===
Windows case-collision (again): the designer file list named statusHeadline.ts (pure) + StatusHeadline.tsx (component). On case-insensitive Windows FS `import { StatusHeadline } from './StatusHeadline'` resolved to the pure statusHeadline.ts (no such named export -> 'Element type is invalid: got undefined'). RENAMED the pure module statusHeadline.ts -> headlineRules.ts (+ headlineRules.test.ts), same as laneB4b's whenPicker->whenRules fix. Updated all imports.
- vitest 2 unhandled-rejection trap: mockRejectedValue(...) on a mocked client fn creates ONE shared rejected promise at setup time; the gap before cancel() awaits it makes vitest flag it as an unhandled rejection and FAIL the test even though the assertion passes. Fix: use mockRejectedValueOnce(new ApiResponseError(...)) (created + consumed in the same tick), mirroring the driver useOfferAccept.test.ts pattern. (A useQuery-based hook does not hit this because TanStack owns the rejection.)

Did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state/pipeline.json. Staged web/ only (dist/, test-results/, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo excluded). All new i18n keys in BOTH cs.json + en.json (parity green), formal Czech 'vy'. Money integer CZK via formatCzk (Intl cs-CZ); timestamps formatted Europe/Prague at render (details time row).

A COLD authed load of an ALREADY-TERMINAL order (Completed/Cancelled) has no active order (getMyActiveOrder returns null) so orderId is null and no SignalR Subscribe runs — the screen still renders the by-code DTO READ-ONLY (status + displayPrice), which is exactly B-history's read-only tracking entry point. This works today for the fields the by-code DTO carries; the rating seam still shows on Completed. No action needed here; B-history opens /c/t/{code} read-only and relies on this path.
